entries.2f33e6e8988f8bd4: This is a service centered on systems such as 'Tsuhan Suru Kura', provided by Softel Co., Ltd., which centrally manage orders, inventory and other operations for EC site operators running multiple stores. It is provided as a private cloud after customization to match customers' needs. Commerce Connect Co., Ltd. is advancing development of an integrated EC platform with next-generation centralized order and inventory management functions utilizing AI. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥850 million.

entries.3c2606c6ea55bc2b: This is a service centered on 'futureshop', a SaaS-based EC site construction platform provided by Future Shop Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,853 million.

entries.7814aa460a2546c8: This is a single-segment business in which the company, as a holding company, oversees 7 consolidated subsidiaries. It mainly provides, in SaaS form, services that support the operation of EC sites for mid-sized and small-to-medium-sized EC site operators in Japan. Its equity-method affiliate, Enecycle Co., Ltd., also works to provide decarbonization solutions using carbonization and gasification technology for biomass resources. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,895 million.
